options.text: For more information about configuring Check Point's NVA, read the administration guide

Thank you for choosing Check Point to secure your Azure Virtual WAN environment; The integration of the Check Point products with your Azure Virtual WAN must be coordinated in advance with a Check Point representative. Please contact your designated Check Point representative, or if you do not have one, use this link.

According to the Azure RBAC security model, a managed identity is required for the managed application to deploy a Network Virtual Appliance (NVA).
The managed Identity must have the following permissions:

1.	Microsoft.Network/virtualHubs/read on the hub that the NVA is being created on.
2.	Microsoft.Network/publicIPAddresses/join/action only if a Public IP is being attached for internet ingress.

elements.name: appIdentity
elements.label: Managed Identity Configuration
elements.toolTip: User assigned managed identities enable Azure resources to authenticate to cloud services (e.g. Azure Key Vault) without storing credentials in code. This type of managed identities are created as standalone Azure resources, and have their own lifecycle. A single resource (e.g. Virtual Machine) can utilize multiple user assigned managed identities. Similarly, a single user assigned managed identity can be shared across multiple resources (e.g. Virtual Machine). Learn more about Managed identities.

options.text:
For SD-WAN full support your NVA will be deployed with 3 NICs which requires hub address space of at least /23.
The current hub address space does not meet this requirement.
Please use hub with larger address space.
If you need only 2 NICs you can go to "CloudGuard advanced settings" and change the number of NICs to 2

For SD-WAN full support your NVA will be deployed with 3 NICs.
To support that, the scale unit must be 10 or higher.
The default is 10 Scale Units - NGTP 8 Gbps.

elements.name: scaleUnit
elements.label: Scale unit
elements.defaultValue: [if(equals(steps('chkp').isSDWAN, 'yes'), '10 Scale Units - NGTP 8 Gbps', '2 Scale Units - NGTP 2.4 Gbps')]
elements.toolTip: The scale unit determines the size and number of resources deployed. The higher the scale unit, the greater the amount of traffic that can be handled.

toolTip.sshPublicKey: Paste an OpenSSH public key. You can generate a key pair using ssh-keygen (Linux, OS X, Cygwin) or PuttyGen (Windows)

options.text: Check Point recommends setting serial console password and maintenance-mode password for recovery purposes.      For R81.10 and below the serial console password is used also as maintenance-mode password. Note: In Azure Virtual Wan there is currently no serial console on the Network Virtual Appliance, the serial console password will be used as a maintenance mode password in R81.10 and below.

options.text: Check Point recommends setting a maintenance-mode password for recovery purposes.

elements.name: MaintenanceModePassword
elements.toolTip: To generate a password hash use the command 'grub2-mkpasswd-pbkdf2' on Linux and paste it here.
